contradictions.title: Semantic Conflict between 'established' and 'insufficient' in Prior Art Status
contradictions.historical_state: Audit JSON used 'established' for parameter substitution while text report stated evidence was 'insufficient'.
contradictions.current_state: Tripartite hypothesis decoupling: 'established' refers strictly to the refutation of naive constant-modulus substitution (H0a); evidence for a distinct new coupling law (H1) is 'insufficient'; existing transformation-aware model (H0b) is 'not falsified'.
contradictions.resolution_rule: RESOLVED_BY_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE: Source precedence resolves semantic ambiguity by decoupling hypotheses H0a, H0b, and H1 as formulated by worker W07 and Astra critique remediation.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: None; semantic definitions are formally standardized across all downstream artifacts.

contradictions.residual_uncertainty: Universal absence of closer prior art outside protocol boundary remains unproven.

contradictions.title: Carboni et al. (2015) Specimen S2a vs S1a Material Attribution
contradictions.original_source: Stage 1 W08 packet asserting S2a proved NiTi pure-bending phase transformation
contradictions.conflicting_source: Carboni et al. (2015) Table 4 in primary PDF (data/papers/verification/MP1-V002/A1-2015-Hysteresis of Multiconfiguration Assemblies of.pdf)
contradictions.historical_state: W08 attributed pure-bending pinched hysteresis of specimen S2a to NiTi phase transformation.
contradictions.current_state: Corrected 100% to primary PDF: Table 4 verifies S2a is ST49 steel strand (pure frictional sliding). S1a is NiTi7 subjected to combined tension-bending with substantial axial preload. Pure-bending NiTi claims expunged.
contradictions.resolution_rule: RESOLVED_BY_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE: Primary full-text PDF overrules secondary worker extraction. False claims of pure-bending NiTi transformation in Carboni 2015 are completely removed.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: None; physical facts verified directly against published Table 4.

contradictions.title: Active Confinement Pressure P3: Mechanics Principle vs Boundary Condition
contradictions.original_source: Stage 1 claims treating positive pressure P3 as a novel constitutive mechanics principle
contradictions.conflicting_source: Continuum mechanics traction boundary derivations (Stage 3 W05) and standard contact mechanics (Tjahjanto 2017)
contradictions.historical_state: Active chamber pressure was claimed to create a novel variable-stiffness mechanics principle.
contradictions.current_state: Pressure enters standard continuum differential equations strictly as a time-varying surface traction boundary condition (sigma · n = -p(t) n). P3 is demoted to an experimental control boundary condition.
contradictions.resolution_rule: RESOLVED_BY_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE: Mathematical mechanics derivation shows standard contact equations naturally accept p(t) without requiring any new constitutive law.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: None regarding principle; transmission mapping p -> f_n remains an experimental challenge.

contradictions.title: Reedlunn et al. (2013) Costello Kinematic Error vs Missing Contact Law
contradictions.original_source: Initial worker inference that Costello model divergence proved need for new constitutive contact law
contradictions.conflicting_source: Reedlunn et al. (2013, Part II) full text (data/papers/verification/MP1-V002/2013-Superelastic shape memory alloy cables Part II – Subcomponent isothermal responses.pdf)
contradictions.historical_state: Costello kinematic error in 1x27 wire ropes was cited as evidence that multi-wire straight bundle contact theory is missing.
contradictions.current_state: Reedlunn's error in steep-helix outer strands is mathematically attributed to Costello kinematics omitting local wire bending and twisting moments, not missing constitutive laws for straight wires. Contact indentations were pre-existing manufacturing artifacts.
contradictions.resolution_rule: RESOLVED_BY_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE: Conservative primary text reading overrules speculative extrapolation.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: None; Costello limitations are well-understood in cable mechanics.

contradictions.title: Parameter Compensation under Free Fitting vs Causal Identifiability
contradictions.original_source: Fang et al. (2019) fitting hysteretic macromodels by floating parameters simultaneously
contradictions.conflicting_source: Astra critique G08 and Locked Calibration Rule requiring independent parameter estimation
contradictions.historical_state: Literature commonly optimizes multiple hysteretic parameters simultaneously to fit cyclic curves.
contradictions.current_state: The Locked Calibration Rule is formally adopted as a mandatory protocol guardrail. However, physical execution of independent parameter measurement (separate single-wire, direct-shear, and membrane-inflation tests) has not yet been conducted in the repository.
contradictions.resolution_rule: STILL_OPEN_NONBLOCKING: Resolved methodologically as a mandatory rule; remains physically open pending future experimental calibration.
contradictions.residual_uncertainty: Risk of parameter cross-talk remains until independent test bench data are obtained.
